source.title: extra-eyes watch loop cargo test pass

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after adding the polling `eyes watch` loop and file snapshotter. Result: 17 unit tests passed and 22 integration tests passed. Coverage includes create/write/delete/rename detection, ignored internal/generated paths, watch-loop default profile resolution, edit-triggered watcher run, debounce of burst edits into one max-tick run, ignored path writes producing no tick, and hook fetch retrieving the watch-produced message.
